**Severity:** error · **Area:** Internal (`RV9xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads one of:

```text
Internal error: compiler panicked: {panic}
```

```text
Internal error: emitted code failed to parse: {message}
```

```text
Internal error: list plan width mismatch
```

```text
Internal error: inlinable component did not lower to a template
```

```text
Internal error: component plan width mismatch
```

```text
Internal error: <{tag}> has no DOM lowering
```

```text
Unknown compilation target
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Compiler bug: simplify or split the reported component to work around it and report the file; for 'Unknown compilation target' pass target "server" or "dom".

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
compile(src, { target: "wasm" })
```

```tsx prefer
compile(src, { target: "dom" })
```

## When it is reported

Also wasm stack overflow on too-deep nesting. 'Unknown compilation target' arguably belongs in RV7001.
